# Third-Party Sources (Submodules)

These repositories are tracked as git submodules to preserve attribution, history, and
licensing. Do not copy code into `examples/` unless the license is compatible and the
file includes clear attribution.

## Submodules
- `third_party/foundry-vtt-community-macros`
  - URL: https://github.com/foundry-vtt-community/macros
  - License: CC-BY-SA-4.0

- `third_party/foundry-vtt-community-tables`
  - URL: https://github.com/foundry-vtt-community/tables
  - License: CC-BY-SA-4.0

- `third_party/foundryvtt-shadowdark`
  - URL: https://github.com/Muttley/foundryvtt-shadowdark
  - License: MIT (code), Shadowdark Third-Party License (content)
